I have never found it so hard to advocate for a patient's care. If this had been a medical service for myself, I would have given up long before now.

The vets themselves are wonderful — knowledgeable, caring, and clearly good at what they do. The problem is everything around them. Medication is simply never ordered. This week alone, it happened twice: my pet, who is in pain, now has to go without treatment until after the weekend because the medication wasn't ordered in time — again.

What makes this worse is how the reception staff handle it. Rather than acknowledging the failure or showing any urgency, I was asked whether I could "be bothered" to drive to another practice to collect medication for an animal in pain. That is not a minor lapse in phrasing — it reflects a complete lack of compassion for what pet owners and their animals are going through.

Even getting through to reception in the first place is its own ordeal. Phone calls routinely sit on hold for around half an hour before anyone picks up, which is simply not acceptable when you're trying to sort out care for a sick animal.

A practice is only as good as its weakest link, and right now that link is the administration. Until medication ordering, phone response times, and reception care catch up with the quality of the vets themselves, I can't recommend this practice to anyone who needs reliable, ongoing treatment for their pet.

This branch of Medivet has looked after all my boys, and today I took Cupid in with a limping paw. Of course, I was nervous and anxious whilst Cupid was dancing around, as he knows there are always treats at the vets and other dogs (and today cats) to meet. The vet put up patiently with him trying to give him a slobbering kiss during his examination, but he was quick, professional, and caring, so I left with the right advice and help with his medication. I cannot thank these vets enough for the help they have provided over the course of the last 15 years!

I had a very disappointing experience with this veterinary clinic.

The attitude and level of care towards my dog were unacceptable. The staff were extremely rude, and the overall experience felt unprofessional and lacking transparency.

I was particularly concerned that certain conditions were suggested in a way that felt unnecessary, seemingly to justify additional tests. After seeking a second opinion from another veterinarian, those concerns were not confirmed.

More seriously, an important symptom in my dog was missed during the consultation, which later required emergency attention elsewhere. This could have had serious consequences.

Based on my experience, I would strongly advise others to exercise caution and consider alternative veterinary services.
